description: A convolution reverb. An impulse response is loaded from a wav or aiff file and the incoming signal is convolved with it as it plays

params.text: Passes the inputs straight to the outputs without convolving them
Sets the output level to the number of dB marked on it
The balance between dry and convolved signal for the early reflections
The balance between dry and convolved signal for the predelay

inputs.text: A pulse switches the bypass on and off
A CV setting the balance between the dry signal and the convolved one

outputs.text: The left output, carrying the convolved signal
The right output, carrying the convolved signal

notes: nothing is convolved until an impulse response is loaded; drop a wav, aif or aiff file onto the module or load one from the menu
a loaded impulse file is copied into a folder named RTimpulse beside the Rack settings, and every impulse in there is listed on the menu, one level of subfolders included
with only one input patched a single convolver runs, which halves the load on the processor
menu: ADD/OPEN an IMPULSE file (wav, aiff) — loads a wav or aiff file as the impulse response
Processing BLOCK SIZE: — sets the block the convolution works in: SET BLOCK SIZE to 256, 512, 1024, 2048 or 4096
Impulse Normalized — normalises the impulse response as it is loaded
Remove Zero Tails From Impulse — trims the silence off the end of the loaded impulse response
Remove Direct Current (DC block) — filters DC out of the output; it starts switched on
Invert Screen — swaps the colours the impulse display is drawn in
